name: Qwen3.5-9B
purpose: Small dense member of Qwen3.5, described on the card as a unified vision-language foundation model; no target-user statement.

license.name: Apache-2.0
license.notes: LICENSE file in the repo read: Apache License 2.0 with the vendor copyright appendix ('Copyright 2026 Alibaba Cloud'), no additional terms. Same md5 as the Qwen3.5-35B-A3B and Qwen3.8-27B LICENSE files.

architecture.kind: dense hybrid Gated DeltaNet + gated attention, vision encoder
architecture.attention: 8 x (3 Gated DeltaNet + 1 gated attention); 16 Q / 4 KV heads, head dim 256
architecture.why_this_design: Card: 'Efficient Hybrid Architecture: Gated Delta Networks combined with sparse Mixture-of-Experts deliver high-throughput inference with minimal latency and cost overhead.'

pc-16gb.notes: Leaves room for a second model.

mac-16-24gb.notes: The practical general model for 16 GB Macs.

engine_support.notes: Dense qwen3_5 module not built in Tona.

strengths: Close to the 35B-A3B on vendor knowledge numbers at a quarter of the file size
weaknesses: Dense 9B reads 5.7 GB per token at Q4: slower decode than the 3 B-active MoE on a card that holds both
soft.behavior: Thinking on by default; enable_thinking=false for direct answers; T=1.0, top_p 0.95, top_k 20, presence_penalty 1.5.
best_for: Small always-on assistant next to a larger model

tona_fit.reason: The small Apache-2.0 (text read) option that fits every class; independent German scores are middling (PeerBench Elo 1060; Gemma 4 12B 1299 is ahead on GermEval, INCLUDE and ScaLA), so it is the pick for 12 GB or 16 GB RAM mainly through the Qwen toolchain. Missing dense qwen3_5 module is only a blocker.
